name: tuya
label: Tuya Smart
description: Smart plugs, lights and sensors through the Tuya cloud: list devices, read their status, and send a command that appears in the allowlist. No schedules and no discovery of a command the operator has not named. Credentials live in the settings store.
guidance: smart plugs, sockets, lights and sensors on the Tuya cloud. Use tuya_devices and tuya_status to read them; tuya_command only sends a code in the Tuya settings allowlist. Ask the home bot for the house.
